text: This report provides an update to the Board of Management on the Toronto Zoo's environmental priorities and initiatives achieved in 2025, presented within the new Sustainability Report framework, which reflects a shift toward more integrated, transparent, and data-driven sustainability reporting. Throughout the year, the Zoo advanced its commitment to net-zero operations by 2030 through initiatives in energy efficiency, water conservation, waste diversion, and biodiversity restoration, while strengthening alignment with broader priorities such as decarbonization, digital transformation, and systems-based environmental management. Increased emphasis on employee engagement and community participation further supports measurable outcomes, positioning the Zoo to effectively track progress, inform decision-making, and contribute to climate resilience within the local ecosystem and beyond.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (April 8, 2026) from the Director, Capital Program and Sustainability, Toronto Zoo, for information.
